description: Resumable Anthropic Claude Code CLI connector that reuses existing CLI authentication, preserves native session IDs, and returns structured print-mode JSON.

sections.title: Claude CLI
sections.text: Resumable Anthropic Claude Code CLI connector using provider-owned authentication and native conversation sessions.
list: Config fields: authentication, optional API key, model, permission mode, workspace, session, timeout, max turns, allowed tools, and system prompt
Output: Structured response, native session ID, Claude events, usage, status, and errors.

sections.title: Typical workflow
sections.intro: Configure Claude CLI with the connection fields and run it as part of a BrainBoost pipeline.

cards.title: Connect
cards.text: Reuse an existing Claude CLI login by default. Configure workspace and permission mode, then optionally select a model or existing session ID.

cards.title: Fetch
cards.text: Start datasource and send chat messages. First turn creates a native Claude session; later turns resume it.

cards.title: Consume
cards.text: Consume normalized response, session ID, native events, usage, and error status from chat UI or downstream automation.

items.q: What do I need to configure?
items.a: Claude Code CLI must be installed and logged in. Existing-session authentication requires no API key. Workspace defaults to datasource process directory and permission mode defaults to default.
Returns structured status, response text, native Claude session ID, events, usage, and errors.
Outputs are emitted to downstream subscribers in the BrainBoost pipeline. Some datasources also write artifacts (context files, catalogs, or exports) locally based on your configuration.

sections.title: Ready to use Claude CLI?
sections.text: Add it to your BrainBoost pipeline and start ingesting.
sections.subtext: Run this datasource locally with your own credentials and storage.
